> **Retro Game Buddy** is a compact, portable retro gaming device designed as a small desktop companion. The project combines embedded electronics, PCB design, programming, and 3D-printed mechanical design into one functional device. The device will feature a small OLED display, directional controls, action buttons, a buzzer/speaker, and a rechargeable battery. It will run simple retro-style games such as Snake, Pong, and Space Shooter, with a menu system for selecting games and displaying scores. The project will initially be developed using a microcontroller-based prototype and then converted into a custom PCB. A custom 3D-printed enclosure will be designed to make the final device compact, durable, and visually appealing. The main goal of the project is to create a fully functional mini gaming device while learning the complete hardware-development process—from circuit design and PCB layout to firmware programming, 3D CAD design, assembly, and testing. .
